prompt: Create a premium vertical editorial fashion portrait with a surreal double-exposure artistic composition. A young woman walks confidently toward the camera in a full-body pose, hands in the front pockets of high-waisted black jeans, wearing a fitted plain black short-sleeve T-shirt and white sneakers. She has long, voluminous, slightly messy wavy dark brown hair with soft bangs, delicate youthful facial features, warm light-to-medium skin, subtle natural makeup, and thin round wire-frame glasses. Behind and above her, blend a much larger close-up portrait of the same woman into the background, showing her face and shoulders with a calm, gentle expression, looking directly at the viewer. The composition contains exactly two depictions of the same woman: one large semi-transparent close-up head-and-shoulders portrait in the upper background and one smaller full-body walking figure centered in the foreground. Surround both figures with dramatic watercolor ink clouds, splashes, drips, and smoky textures in deep emerald green, black, charcoal gray, and white, spreading outward like an abstract painted aura. Use an off-white textured paper background with visible grain, irregular ink blotches, vertical paint runs, and scattered splatter marks. Add a glossy reflective wet floor at the bottom, mirroring the green and black ink and the lower body subtly. Lighting should feel cinematic and editorial, with soft sunlight highlights on the hair, realistic skin texture, sharp facial detail, and a premium magazine-cover finish. Keep the subject centered, vertical 9:16 framing, full-body figure from head to shoes visible, large portrait cropped near the top edge, no text, no logo, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张高级垂直编辑类时尚肖像，采用超现实的双重曝光艺术构图。一位年轻女性全身出镜，正自信地朝镜头走来，双手插在黑色高腰牛仔裤的前口袋里，身穿修身纯黑色短袖 T 恤和白色运动鞋。她留着 长而蓬松、略显凌乱的深棕色波浪卷发，配有柔和的刘海，面部轮廓精致年轻，肤色为温暖的浅至中等色调，妆容自然清透，并佩戴着 细圆框眼镜。在她的身后上方，将同一位女性的超大特写肖像融入背景，展现她平静温柔的面部表情，直视镜头。构图包含该女性的两个形象：背景上方是一个巨大的半透明头部及肩部特写，前景中心是一个较小的全身行走形象。在两个形象周围环绕着戏剧性的水彩墨云、飞溅、滴落和烟雾纹理，颜色采用 深祖母绿、黑色、炭灰色和白色，如同抽象的绘画光晕般向外扩散。使用带有可见纹理的米白色纸张作为背景，呈现不规则的墨迹、垂直的颜料流痕和零星的喷溅点。底部添加光亮的湿润反光地面，微妙地映衬出绿色和黑色的墨迹以及下半身。光影需具备电影感和杂志大片质感，发丝带有柔和的阳光高光，皮肤纹理真实，面部细节清晰，呈现出高级杂志封面的效果。保持主体居中，采用 9:16 垂直构图，全身形象从头到鞋清晰可见，大型肖像在顶部边缘附近裁剪，无文字、无 Logo、无水印。
